d: The Head Baker at Silversea Cruises is a senior culinary leadership role responsible for overseeing onboard bakery operations and delivering exceptional, luxury-level baked goods. This position focuses on creating high-quality artisan breads, viennoiserie, and specialty dietary products while ensuring consistency, innovation, and strict adherence to international standards and company procedures. Working with a top-tier culinary team, the Head Baker plays a key role in enhancing the guest dining experience across premium venues, maintaining excellence in production, and contributing to the brand’s commitment to outstanding, memorable dining at sea.
Reporting to Pastry Chef and Executive Chef
q: Proven experience as Head Baker or Senior Baker in a luxury hotel, Michelin-starred restaurant, or cruise line.
Advanced knowledge of artisanal bread baking, laminated doughs, and modern dietary alternatives.
Culinary degree or equivalent certification preferred.
Cruise ship or international hospitality experience is highly advantageous.
Appropriate certification as required by regulations.
In-depth understanding of USPH, ILO, ISO, HACCP, and maritime safety procedures.
Superior ability to deliver an excellent and consistent culinary experience while maintaining sound cost control.
Strong leadership and organizational skills in a high-volume, fine-dining production environment.
Willing to travel extensively and be willing to spend extended periods at sea.
Fluent English (verbal and written) is mandatory.
Additional languages (French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Mandarin) are considered a plus.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft applications, Fidelio and MXP.
r: Lead Production: Oversee and actively participate in daily preparation of breads, pastries, and bakery items across all onboard dining venues, including special events.
Artisanal Baking: Create high-quality baked goods such as sourdough, laminated pastries, gluten-free items, and regionally inspired specialties aligned with luxury standards.
Collaboration: Follow company standards and recipes while working with the Executive Chef, Pastry Chef, and Fleet Corporate Pastry Chef to develop and adapt bakery offerings.
Quality Assurance: Maintain exceptional consistency, presentation, and attention to detail in all bakery products.
Sanitation & Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to USPH, HACCP, and company hygiene and safety standards, keeping operations clean and efficient.
Inventory Management: Monitor stock levels, manage requisitions, control portions, and reduce waste through effective production planning.
Team Leadership: Train, supervise, and mentor bakery staff, promoting high standards and professional growth.
Guest Interaction: Engage with guests during culinary events and demonstrations, enhancing their onboard experience.

q: Additional Skills : Must have experience in 1. Design and development of enterprise applications taking into consideration factors such as application performance, security and scalability 2. System Design aimed for long term stability and performance 3. Troubleshooting and fixing of Production issues

d: We are partnered with a high-performing, multi-strategy hedge fund with over $10bn in AUM, seeking a Quantitative Researcher to join a leading Fixed Income team and work directly alongside a Portfolio Manager specialising in rates volatility.

This is a front-office opportunity within one of the firm's top-performing teams, offering direct PM exposure and the chance to develop proprietary analytics, pricing models, and systematic relative-value strategies across the rates market.
Develop and implement quantitative models, pricing frameworks, and risk analytics across fixed income and rates volatility products.
Take ownership of curve construction, risk measurement, P&L attribution, and valuation analytics across government bonds, interest rate futures, swaps, and options.
Research and develop systematic relative-value strategies across rates volatility, including OTC swaptions, listed options, caps, and floors.
Work directly with Portfolio Managers to identify trading opportunities, refine existing models, and translate research into actionable investment strategies.
Build and maintain bespoke tools for hedging, risk management, scenario analysis, trade attribution, and execution optimisation.
Collaborate with technology and operations teams to deploy and maintain robust, production-ready research and trading infrastructure.
Operate directly on the trading desk, with the opportunity to develop proprietary alpha signals and progress towards implementing and running strategies.
q: Advanced degree in a quantitative or STEM discipline from a leading university.
5+ years of experience in quantitative research focused on rates volatility, ideally within a buy-side hedgefund.
Strong Python programming skills, with experience developing production-grade quantitative tools and systems.
Deep understanding of fixed income markets, interest rate derivatives, volatility products, curve dynamics, and risk analytics.
Strong research and problem-solving capabilities, with the initiative to take ownership of projects in a high-performance, front-office environment.
3–5 years of relevant experience in compliance, logistics operations, fleet management, or regulatory audit within Saudi Arabia.
Bachelor's in Supply Chain Management, Engineering or any other related discipline.
Excellent verbal and written communication in Arabic and English.
Familiarity with delivery platform operations, last-mile fleet management, or quick-commerce regulatory landscapes.
r: Monitor rider permit validity, vehicle documentation, work authorizations, and road safety compliance, identifying recurring risk patterns rather than one-off exceptions.
Independently conduct scheduled compliance audits across operational channels and document findings, gaps, and root causes.
Support the rollout of updated regulatory guidelines into daily rider operations, ensuring accurate on-ground implementation.
Contribute directly to reviewing and updating compliance procedures, risk mitigation protocols, and SOPs.
Draft and track corrective action plans for non-compliant rider cases and operational bottlenecks.
Identify and propose process improvement opportunities based on audit trends.
